descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: real-device variant.

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S22 Real phone with a wrong date or another time zone

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Today' on the timeline comes from the server clock, not the device's; a device with a wrong date, no clock set or a different time zone shows the same state as any other device. (UAT 3.8; TFA-92589 AC 7)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack only (never the store / TestFlight build, never dev): a native dev build pointed at the local Convex, or the phone's browser on the LAN Vite URL, with an @roundai.test account. One iPhone or Android set to yesterday's date, one set 1 day ahead, one in a different time zone, plus one correct device, all on …

When Finish a Nursing Home visit on the wrong-date phone; open the same Hospital patient and resident on every device; bring an app back to the front after midnight

Then Every device shows the same timeline; the new entry carries the server's date; every device can sign in

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The tester compares screenshots across devices (3.8 'Test with one device set to the wrong date'). The time-zone device is Q4

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S22

New local lane newspec-c: status record-only in newspec-c/results.json → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Our addition (10-15 review): recorded only. (A) Phone one day behind finished a Nursing Home visit (scripted note and course line): the entry reads 'Visit 1 – Oct 15: …' (the real day) on the phone and on the desktop - the server-clock label of TFA-92589 works. (B) The app was sent to the background, the phone's clock jumped a day ahead (past its midnight), and the app came back: it ended the session and asked for sign-in (run 1 showed 'Your session has ended. Taking you to sign in…'; known B33); after signing in, a Hospital pre-round save wrote 'Oct 15: …', again the real day on both devices. (C) The phone a day ahead, data wiped, signed in through its form with a new code and reached the app (so the new sign-in itself works). (D) A phone at the real time in Pacific/Honolulu wrote the resident's entry as 'Visit 2 – Oct 14: …' (its local day; the desktop's day is Oct 15), so the resident now shows Visit 2 dated a day before Visit 1 on every device - the time-zone device is Q4.
